Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2.  The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.211 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376(3),
354-D IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3/5 of The Uttar Pradesh Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act, Police Station Ashiyana, District Lucknow.

entities.text: Uttar Pradesh Prohibition of Unlawful Conversion of Religion Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the sister of the informant was missing and was had taken certain jewelleries also.
Subsequently in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that the applicant wanted to marry with the victim, however, she refused.
It is admitted that they were on talking term.
Similar statement was given under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
The victim refused to undergo medical examination.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the two statements and the fact that the victim has refused to undergo medical examination; the age of the victim is around 16 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 20.06.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mosin @ Moseem be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
